messages:
nina (Sales): Quick questionran into this on a client trip. Bought an open-return rail ticket via our travel agency on the company card. Train got canceled and agency issued a partial refund as a credit on their portal, not back to card. Submitted expense and got a "missing refund" flag. What counts as proof?
leo (Finance): We need documentation showing original charge and the agency credit details (amount, credit code/ID, date). If the credit wasn't returned to your card, the agency confirmation that they applied a credit toward your itinerary is acceptable.
harper (Travel Ops): Ask the agent for an email that states: ticket number, credit amount, credit ID, and whether credit reduced what the agency billed to the company. A screenshot of the agency portal with the credit + URL + timestamp also works.
nina (Sales): Agent sent a portal screenshot but it's behind their login; screenshot includes my name and the credit line. Will that do?
leo (Finance): Yes, include the portal screenshot and the portal URL. Also attach the original e-receipt showing the company card charge. We'll mark the credit as an offset during reconciliation.
maya (Manager): Approving the expense pending docs. I confirm the trip change was work-required.
expenses-bot: Reminder: upload files as PDF/PNG <5MB. If portal screenshot is used, include agent's email confirming it and your manager approval.
harper (Travel Ops): Note on timing: if agency credits future bookings (voucher style), Finance will net it against travel costs in the same booking window. If the credit sits on the agency account for you personally, we treat it as personal credit and will still reimburse refundable portions you paid.
nina (Sales): One more nuance  agency charged a EUR 15 administration fee and didn't refund that. Can I expense the admin fee?
leo (Finance): Administration fees related to the booking change are reimbursable if incurred due to the change. Attach the agent invoice or fee line. If the fee is non-refundable and retained by agency, we still reimburse that as an expense line.
nina (Sales): Cool. I'll upload portal screenshot, original e-receipt, and the agent email. Expense ID EXP-2106009 in notes.
expenses-bot: Files received. Expense EXP-2106009 is awaiting review. Missing: agent email verification if screenshot lacks agent stamp.
leo (Finance): Once docs are complete we'll clear flags. Expect reimb/payment reconciliation in ~4 business days.
nina (Sales): Thanks all "
